name: Disability Relief Allowance Scheme
benefit:
Following is the assistance provided:

   1. Pensioners with 40-69% disability ₹1150/- per month 
   1. Pensioners with 70% disability or more ₹1700/- per month 
   1. Pensioners with disability aged 70 years or more ₹1500/- per month
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
   1. The applicant must have a minimum of 40% disability.
   1. The applicant must not receive any other pension or allowance from the state or central government.

<br>
